name: Audit Report Archive
size_unit: catalog URLs; NOT unique audit engagements

date_coverage: 2015 through 2026-10-15 among syntactically valid catalog dates; target 2016-2026 partly covered.
date_origin: Best-effort catalog date. Generic GitHub scraper prefers filename date, then oldest commit touching the file; the latter is a publication proxy, not audit completion.
firm_coverage: 46 nonempty source catalogs; Broad firms plus Code4rena/Sherlock/Cantina/Hats; not an industry census.
fields_available: source/firm key; project; title; date; report_url; download_url; listing_url; file_type; local_path; sha256; size_bytes; downloaded_at; extra(repo/path/commit); separate partial chain/language/category enrichment. Findings/severity not extracted.
originals_included: Git repository: metadata/indexes only. Separate HF mirror has 6562 report files (PDF/HTML/MD); do not assume README mirror count.
access_method: Read-only GitHub REST trees and raw files; git clone possible, but no repository code was run.
rate_limits: GitHub REST unauthenticated core 60 requests/hour/IP; search has a separate lower bucket (observed 10/minute). Honor response headers and pagination; clone/raw delivery have separate abuse controls.
licence_and_terms: No root LICENSE detected; HF card license:other. Maintainer says copyright remains with firms. Technical availability of HF files does not authorize public redistribution.
quality_issues: 22678 URLs collapse to 9965 revision-normalized URL keys; 9377 local paths but 9005 hashed/download-timestamp records and 8849 unique hashes. 58 syntactically malformed nonempty dates. Origin links not re-downloaded; no completeness guarantee.
